title: Core Referral Visits for Active Specialist Use and Surgical Planning — Primary Care Provider Assignment
content:
**Utilization management decision table — core visits of a single specialist referral under the Primary Care Provider Assignment.**

**Rule.** The core visits depend on the member's specialist use and on surgical planning: a member with at least the active-use count of **2** paid specialist-visit claims with a service date in the specialist look-back window of **12 months** and who also has an **Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization** request on file under **Prior Authorization** in submitted, pended-for-information or approved status receives the surgical-care visits of **8**; a member who meets exactly one of those two conditions receives the active-care visits of **6**; a member who meets neither receives the standard referral visits.

**Condition 1 — specialist use.** Paid claims in the specialist-visit category booked on the member's **Medicaid Managed Care Membership**, any specialist, with a service date in the last 12 months. The look-back window is a trailing period counted back from the handling date in whole months: a claim is inside it when fewer than 12 whole months separate its service date from the handling date, so a claim dated exactly 12 months back is outside it.

**Condition 2 — surgical planning.** An Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization request whose status is submitted, pended for information, or approved. A request that is denied, expired, voided or withdrawn does not meet the condition.

| Paid specialist-visit claims in the last 12 months | Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization request submitted, pended for information or approved | Core visits |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | Yes | 8 |
| 2 or more | No | 6 |
| 0 or 1 | Yes | 6 |
| 0 or 1 | No | The standard referral visits |

**Both sides of the use threshold (hypothetical members with no surgical request)**

- 2 paid specialist-visit claims in the last 12 months: 6 core visits.
- 1 paid specialist-visit claim: neither condition met, the standard referral visits.

**Worked case (hypothetical).** A member has 3 paid specialist-visit claims in the last 12 months and an Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization request pended for information: both conditions met, 8 core visits. Had the request been denied, one condition would be met: 6 core visits.
